full_prompt_en: A square storybook painting shows an intricate village spread across small green islands and winding blue waterways beneath a busy cloud-filled sky. A narrow dark frame holds the scene. At the top center, a bright circular sun radiates through concentric cream and pale gold strokes, while blue-gray and white clouds curl around it in many small whorls. A warm striped balloon floats at the upper left, and a smaller distant balloon appears near the horizon on the right. Below, a broad central island holds a cluster of steep-roofed houses, a taller pale building with a small tower, and many dark pointed trees. A cream footpath enters from the lower middle, curves around rounded shrubs, and climbs toward the main buildings. To the right of the island, a slender arched bridge crosses a blue channel toward more houses on the far bank. Additional small homes occupy the lower corners; their windows glow softly, while varied brick, timber, and pale wall surfaces keep the architecture distinct. The water branches around the settlement in gentle S curves. Fine light strokes run along its surface and tiny boat shapes punctuate the channels. Soft olive, moss, and ocher vegetation fills the spaces between paths and roofs, with miniature details repeated throughout the scene. The viewpoint is elevated so the islands, bridges, and distant shore remain legible at once. Light comes from the high central sun, laying a gentle cream glow over roofs and cloud edges; darker blue and green recesses preserve depth. The overall composition is densely detailed but orderly, balancing the huge patterned sky with a network of curved water, paths, and compact built forms.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形童话绘画呈现小绿岛和蜿蜒蓝色水道间精细铺开的村镇，上方是忙碌的多云天空。狭窄深色边框围住景象。顶部中央，一轮明亮圆日透过奶油色与浅金色同心笔迹发光，蓝灰和白色云朵以许多小涡旋环绕它。左上方漂浮着暖色条纹气球，右侧地平线附近还有一个更小的远方气球。下方，宽阔中央岛屿承载陡顶房屋群、一栋带小塔的较高浅色建筑以及许多深色尖树。一条奶油色步道从下部中央进入，绕过圆润灌木，爬向主要建筑。岛屿右侧，一座细窄拱桥跨过蓝色水道，通向对岸更多房子。下方两角也有小屋；窗户柔和发亮，砖、木和浅色墙面各不相同。水流以柔和的S形绕过聚落。细浅笔迹沿水面行进，微小船形点在水道中。柔和橄榄绿、苔绿和赭黄色植物填满小路与屋顶之间的空间，整幅画反复布着微型细节。视点较高，使岛屿、桥梁和远岸能够同时辨认。光来自高处中央太阳，在屋顶和云缘铺上柔和奶油色辉光；较暗的蓝绿凹处保留纵深。整体构图细节密集却有秩序，以巨大的纹样天空平衡曲线水道、小路和紧凑建筑形体的网络。
style_prompt_en: The storybook painting fills a compact frame with small, carefully separated forms and a lively network of curving lines. Slate blue, muted teal, moss green, ocher, brick brown, and warm cream repeat in balanced clusters rather than broad uniform blocks. Fine dark contours keep miniature areas distinct; tiny highlights, short hatch marks, and textured stippling give surfaces a hand-worked grain. Rounded spirals and soft arcs animate the upper space, while winding bands and repeated narrow uprights organize the denser lower area. An elevated viewpoint allows many overlapping layers to remain visible, and gradual reduction in scale opens a gentle depth. Light concentrates around one high pale center, then scatters in smaller warm accents across the frame, with cool recesses providing separation. The overall effect is ornate and welcoming, with disciplined detail, rhythmic curves, and tactile color making a densely populated composition easy to explore.
style_prompt_zh: 这种童话绘画在紧凑画幅中填入众多彼此分明的小形状和活跃的曲线网络。石板蓝、低饱和青绿、苔绿、赭黄、砖褐与暖奶油色以平衡的色群反复出现，而非铺成整片均一色块。细深轮廓使微小区域各自清楚；小高光、短排线和有肌理的点触让表面带有手工颗粒。圆润螺旋和柔和弧线激活上方空间，蜿蜒色带及反复的细竖形组织更密的下方区域。较高视点让多个叠压层次仍然可见，尺度逐渐缩小打开温和纵深。光集中在上方一处浅亮中心，随后以更小暖色重音散落全画，冷色凹处提供分隔。整体效果华丽而亲切，以有纪律的细节、富节奏的曲线和可触知的色彩让密集构图易于游览。
theme_en: An intricate island village among winding waterways beneath a spiral sun
theme_zh: 螺旋形太阳下，精细的岛屿村镇散布在蜿蜒水道间
name: Bill Bell
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
